title: Pan-Seared Squid with Citrus and Herbs
description: A simple and flavorful recipe that highlights the delicate flavor of squid. Perfect for a quick dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add olive oil and swirl to coat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add squid and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer squid to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add lemon and orange juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return squid to the skillet and toss to coat with citrus sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with parsley and serve immediately.
